hook: An open-source Figma alternative that writes real code.

beats.say: Onlook, from Y Combinator's Winter 2025 batch, is a free, local-first editor where designers craft experiences in code.
You see your real app running live on a canvas, shape it visually, and let your own agent write the code. They don't ship a model.
It pitches itself as an open-source alternative to Figma, V0, Replit Agent and Webflow, under the Apache 2.0 license.
